title: Tsareena V 021/264 - Ultra Rare - Pokemon Fusion Strike
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This card features the character Tsareena from the Pokémon TCG game in the Fusion Strike set. It is an Ultra Rare card with a card number of 021/264 and is made of card stock material. The card is standard sized and in English language. 

It is suitable for collectors of all ages and is a great addition to any collection. This card is not vintage and is perfect for those who are just starting to collect. Get your hands on this rare and powerful card today!
